bull_bear.body:
- Board approved a rights issue of up to ₹100 Cr (2026), building on capital raised via the Company's NSE/BSE listing, to fund the Marol and Jaipur capacity expansion.
- Balance sheet has deleveraged materially, with the D/E ratio falling from 2.37x (FY23) to 0.36x (FY26) alongside rising ROE (38.08% in FY26) and ROCE (32.06% in FY26), signalling a shift toward equity-funded, capital-efficient growth.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Design-led, fully integrated gold jewellery manufacturer built on deep promoter/founder expertise (21+ years) and trusted long-standing relationships with marquee retailers (Joyalukkas, Lalithaa, Alukkas, Vysyaraju, Shree Kalptaru).
- Pan-India presence across 15 states and 2 Union Territories, with a growing global footprint spanning 4 international markets.
- Positions itself as uniquely placed - combining design innovation, client trust, and scalable manufacturing - to capture India's organised gold jewellery growth story.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Listing] Company completed its listing on NSE and BSE (NSE Symbol: SHANTIGOLD; BSE Scrip Code: 544459).
- [Corporate History] Began in 2003 as the partnership firm 'M/s. Shanti Gold' and was converted into a public limited company, 'Shanti Gold International Limited', on November 1, 2013.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: Shanti Gold positions itself as a design-led, fully integrated gold jewellery manufacturer scaling installed capacity and product breadth (Turkish jewellery, plain gold) to capture India's organised jewellery growth story.
